svg.title: Antidote holistic two-rate architecture
svg.desc: A numbered architecture separates human-correctable deliberation, variable-latency generation, deterministic audio rendering, actual exposure, and response records. A single approved generation specification enters the bounded model adapter. Component labels distinguish the executable synthetic slice from proposed capabilities and unavailable human evidence. Stop bypasses deliberation, while any future learning remains a human-reviewed proposal.
svg.text: Verified future audio decouples variable model work from deterministic playback deadlines.
Uncertain deliberation remains visible, editable, and human-authorized.
ILLUSTRATIVE AUDIO FLOW · NOT A MEASUREMENT
